company.name: Karius
company.shortDescription: Karius delivers genomic insights into infectious diseases, helping clinicians make critical, life-saving treatment decisions.
company.description: Karius is a life sciences company focused on generating genomic insights for infectious diseases with a liquid biopsy for infectious diseases. The Karius Test that helps clinicians make rapid, treatment decisions.  By mapping each patient’s microbial landscape from a single blood draw, Karius moves closer to a vision of a world where infectious disease is no longer  a major threat to human health. The Karius laboratory is CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited to perform high-complexity clinical laboratory testing.

productsAndServices.description: A blood test using metagenomic sequencing of plasma microbial cell-free DNA to detect over 1,000 pathogens causing systemic infections.
productsAndServices.name: Karius Spectrum™

productsAndServices.description: A diagnostic test for detecting pathogens in bronchoalveolar lavage samples to aid in managing suspected lung infections in immunocompromised patients.
productsAndServices.name: Karius Focus™ | BAL

aiResearchSummary.text: Karius is researching methods for preparing nucleic acid libraries from samples containing both microbial and human nucleic acids, as described in 'Sample processing to enrich for select species of nucleic acids.' They are developing approaches for detecting active microbial infections, including in transplant recipients, as detailed in 'Microbial biomarkers in transplantation and related methods.' Their work also includes rapid, non-invasive detection and monitoring of infections using microbial cell-free DNA sequencing. These areas define their R&D focus.
